title: Lidarr Release Track Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lidarr:release track_count=*
| stats sum(track_count) as total_value, avg(track_count) as avg_value by artist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks artist values by total and average track count across Lidarr release events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `track_count` values for each Lidarr release event and review total and average track count by artist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total track count.
grandmaExplanation: It charts which artist shows the biggest track count numbers in your Lidarr release data.
